user.title: Grundfos MAGNA3
user.description: Connect to a Grundfos MAGNA3 pump with a CIM 200 (Modbus RTU) or CIM 500 (Modbus TCP) module.

data_description.device_id: The Modbus slave address of the CIM module (1-247).

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the CIM 500 module or Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.scan_interval: How often the pump is polled.

data_description.device: The serial port connected to the CIM 200 module.
data_description.parity: CIM 200 supports even parity with 1 stop bit (default) or no parity with 2 stop bits.

general.name: General
general.description: Channels and options shared by every notification.

data_description.notify_persistent: Also show notifications as persistent notifications in the Home Assistant interface.

connection.name: Connection errors
connection.description: Notifications when the Modbus connection is lost or the pump stops responding to the CIM module.

data_description.connection_notify_recovery: Send a notification once the connection is restored.
data_description.connection_notify_services: Mobile services that receive connection notifications only.
data_description.connection_error_delay: How long the connection must be lost before a notification is sent.
data_description.connection_quiet_hours_enabled: During quiet hours, mobile notifications are held and delivered once the period ends. Persistent notifications are never held.

data_description.alarm_notify_recovery: Send a notification once the alarm has cleared.
data_description.alarm_notify_services: Mobile services that receive alarm notifications only.
data_description.alarm_delay: An alarm is re-checked after this delay before a notification is sent; this avoids notifications for short-lived alarms.
data_description.alarm_quiet_hours_enabled: During quiet hours, mobile alarm notifications are held and delivered once the period ends. Persistent notifications are never held.

data_description.warning_notify_recovery: Send a notification once the warning has cleared.
data_description.warning_notify_services: Mobile services that receive warning notifications only.
data_description.warning_delay: A warning is re-checked after this delay before a notification is sent; this avoids notifications for short-lived warnings.
data_description.warning_quiet_hours_enabled: During quiet hours, mobile warning notifications are held and delivered once the period ends. Persistent notifications are never held.
